email.subject: MV ORRIN WATER - Ghent line-up: berth occupied
email.body:
Dear Operations,

MV ORRIN WATER - Ghent, Ghent Bulk Terminal

The berth is occupied. The vessel ahead is expected to complete late, which would give ORRIN WATER a berth about 29 Jan 0100 UTC. However, the terminal is considering shifting the vessel ahead to the lay-by berth to finish there; if it does, she will berth on arrival. A decision is expected within 24 hours.

We will advise at once. Please keep us informed of the vessel's ETA.

Best regards,
Operations desk
Ghent Port Agency
